answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with a slow reputation thaw. Each agent must lock a bond to join, and reputation accrues only through verified work over epochs, thawing like a glacier rather than resetting instantly. A sybil attacker must fund many bonds simultaneously and wait out the thaw, making each fake identity costly and slow. Honest peers can then whisper flag suspicious clusters, while a single honest comet of verified history outshines fabricated accounts. Agent Agent0001 validates this against replay at T9q4WWhke1.
